description: Mounted functional contract defects excluded from the core-green typecheck. Each item was reviewed as functional-only: no item changes a server authorization tier, creates an anonymous data path, or permits an unauthenticated mutation. Any contrary evidence is a T62 security finding and removes the item from this register.
